deadline.value: Apply by April 1, 2027 as an international applicant for September entry (Canadians June 1).
deadline.quote: April 1 (international) / June 1 (Canadian) for a September start.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: You must find a supervisor who will support and fund your research before you are accepted.
supervisor.quote: Before being accepted into the program, you need to find a supervisor who can support your research interests, provide funding and has the capacity to take on the supervisory responsibility.

funding.value: PhD students are admitted with funding tied to a professor's research project, confirmed by the supervisor; you can also apply for faculty and FGS scholarships.
funding.quote: The Faculty of Computer Science admits PhD students with funding tied to research projects, and you can also apply for Faculty assessed and FGS scholarships. | Ultimately, funding is therefore confirmed by a professor who agrees to supervise your PhD.

entry_route.value: A master's in CS or a related field with an A- average is normally required; an exceptional post-bachelor route may be considered.
entry_route.quote: A Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field is normally required with a minimum A ... an exceptional post bachelor pathway may be considered.

notes: Needs a 700-word research proposal, CV and two references.
